purpose: Controlled pilot of diagnostic behavior, not a representative fault prevalence study
mse_alarm: Above empirical 95th percentile of clean-reference MSE on development seeds; invalid point arrays alarm. Ignores indexes and other outputs.
repair: Disable the single output mutation and regenerate from identical inputs/seeds; separately repair an omitted inverse transformation in a model implementation.

real_data.name: AirPassengers
real_data.replication: Four ordered origins in one series; no independent-series confidence interval

uncertainty: Wilson 95% intervals for rates; paired t intervals across independent seeds for score differences; exploratory multiple comparisons, no familywise claim
limitations: Output fault fixtures are hand selected
No automatic diagnosis of causal bug locations
No parameter or generator-family holdout in this pilot
Real-data example is one known implementation defect on one dataset
